adapter.words: write_day makes ONE list_objects_v2 call with Bucket and Prefix, after the existing refusals and before any put. When the response lists any object it raises GoldWriteError, naming the day, with no put. An empty partition receives the two puts as before. run_day is unchanged; the error propagates.

handler.words: owed_days owes nothing while T-1 is before FLOOR_DAY and never owes a day before it: the first owed day is the later of the day after newest_landed and the floor. lambda_handler refuses the WHOLE event, dry_run included, before any client is created or any read is made, when a day named by day or days is before the floor.
